$comment: FROZEN EVIDENCE PROCEDURE, version 1 (openspec sgwb-detection-route task 1.10).
The sgwb/model-selection spec requires the evidence procedure be recorded as a fixed,
versioned configuration and applied unchanged to every subsequent dataset in the
scale-up, with each run recording which frozen version it used. This file is that
record. It describes what is ALREADY being done -- it is a formalisation of a freeze
that has been honoured informally since task 1.8 -- and changes nothing about how any
SCOPE. This freezes the EVIDENCE procedure only: how ln B(HD/CURN) is obtained from a
set of runs. It does NOT freeze the noise model, the priors or the pulsar selection.
Those belong to sgwb/array-analysis-procedure and are frozen separately at task 6.8,
after the NG15 subset stage. Recording them here would freeze, before the evidence
exists, a choice (flat per-pulsar red-noise priors) so far validated only on MDC2 1b,
which the IPTA dataset table lists as white-noise-only and is therefore the one dataset
where flat priors are the true model.
CHANGING THIS FILE MARKS DOWNSTREAM RESULTS STALE. Per the spec: results produced under
an older version are not to be combined with new ones. Bump the version, do not edit v1.

estimator.name: path_sampling
estimator.label: estimator B -- thermodynamic integration along the correlation path
estimator.identity: ln B(HD/CURN) = ln Z(1) - ln Z(0) = int_0^1 E_eps[ d lnL / d eps ] d eps

rejected_alternative.name: generalised Savage-Dickey (estimator A)
rejected_alternative.status: retained as a cheap one-run first look, NOT as production
rejected_alternative.reason: agreed on value (0.105 +/- 0.095 vs 0.175 +/- 0.017, 0.73 sigma) but failed its own fold_agreement gate, i.e. it declines to certify in the regime this project is in

ladder.spacing_rationale: uniform spacing is what lets the estimator coarsen 5 -> 3 -> 2 and estimate its own discretisation error by Romberg extrapolation
ladder.rungs_are: independent NUTS runs at fixed eps, embarrassingly parallel across GPUs

reliability_gates.on_failure: the estimator reports reliable: false and names the failing diagnostic; it does not return nan

uncertainty: total = hypot(MCMC uncertainty, Romberg residual) -- the discretisation error is folded in as a systematic, not reported separately

gw_parameterization.rationale: straightens the curved ha<->gamma_a ridge that stalled the direct-basis runs (issue #109)

readout.batch_size_required: yes -- the integrand evaluation is OOM-killed without it
readout.run_as: SLURM CPU job, never the login node (a login-node readout took 6h33m at 36 GB and can be reaped)
readout.scrambled_ladders: must go through scripts/lnb_scrambled.py; --evaluate rebuilds the data from the config and would otherwise integrate against the TRUE ORF, returning a well-formed and meaningless number

comparability.requirement: sgwb/model-selection -- HD and CURN differ ONLY in the overlap reduction function
comparability.curn_construction: eps = 0, at which correlation_path returns the identity for any input geometry
